info.name: RAG Learning Lab — Local API
info.description: Local FastAPI backend. No authentication header is required. Start the backend using the RAG Backend (local) PyCharm configuration. base_url defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000. Import this JSON into Postman; no separate environment is required. Send Health, select a file and Upload, then List, Search and Chat. Delete is optional cleanup and removes stored data. For Collection Runner, select the upload file first and deselect Delete if you want to keep it. OPENAI_API_KEY belongs in the backend root .env, never in Postman; restart the backend after changing it. A 503 may indicate missing/invalid upstream configuration; inspect the error.code and error.message response. While PyCharm is paused at a breakpoint, requests wait until Resume.

variable.description: Saved automatically after upload. Used by Delete; can also scope Search/Chat.

request.description: Checks PostgreSQL and reports indexed chunks. No OpenAI call.

In Body → form-data, select a local file for the file field (for example samples/permit.txt). PDF must contain extractable text; TXT must be UTF-8. Default upload limit: 20 MB. Do not manually add Content-Type: Postman supplies the multipart boundary. Requires the backend OPENAI_API_KEY for embeddings. A successful upload saves its ID to the collection variable document_id.

formdata.description: Choose a local PDF, DOCX or TXT file.

request.description: Returns uploaded document IDs and metadata. No OpenAI call.

Semantic retrieval without generating an answer. Upload a document first. document_ids: null searches all documents; use [{{document_id}}] to search the last upload, or [] to select none. top_k accepts 1–20. Requires backend embeddings credentials when searching indexed documents.

exec: pm.test("Retrieval results are a list", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().results).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: Retrieves passages and generates an answer with sources. Upload a document first. document_ids: null searches all documents; use [{{document_id}}] to use the last upload, or [] to select none. Requires backend OpenAI credentials. Each question is independent; no conversation history is sent.

request.description: Deletes the document metadata, chunks and vectors. document_id is set by a successful upload; alternatively set it manually from List documents. This request changes stored data. Send only when you want to remove that document; deselect it in Collection Runner if you want to keep the upload.
